class.name: NavMeshStitching
class.brief_description: Tiled navmesh stitching, polygon graph, A* and funnel path smoothing (static helpers).
class.description: Tiles are dictionaries [code]{"origin": Vector2, "size": float, "polygons": Array[PackedVector2Array]}[/code]. [method stitch] finds polygon edges lying on the border shared by two tiles; [method build_graph] builds the polygon adjacency graph; [method find_path] runs A* over polygons followed by the Simple Stupid Funnel algorithm. The concepts follow Recast and Detour tiled navmeshes; the implementation is original.

method.name: stitch
method.description: Returns portal links [code]{poly_a, poly_b, left, right}[/code] across the border of two touching tiles.

method.name: build_graph
method.description: Builds a polygon graph [code]{polys, centers, links, tile_of, offsets}[/code] from intra-tile shared edges and stitched tile borders.

method.name: find_path
method.description: Finds a smoothed path through [param graph]. Returns an empty array when no route exists.

method.name: funnel
method.description: Runs the funnel algorithm over [code][left, right][/code] portal pairs; the first must be [code][start, start][/code] and the last [code][goal, goal][/code].
